settings.text: Free UK mainland delivery on every bed

settings.heading: We sell beds, and only beds
settings.text:
Comfort Crest is a small UK company in Bury, Greater Manchester. We stock ottoman storage beds, divan sets and bases, and we keep the range deliberately short so we know every product on it properly.

Delivery is free to the UK mainland with no minimum spend, beds are dispatched in one to four working days, and if you need to talk to someone you get one of us rather than a call centre.

settings.title: Order online
settings.text: Delivery is free to any UK mainland address, with no minimum spend. The price you see is the price you pay.

settings.title: We dispatch in 1–4 working days
settings.text: Express Dispatch beds leave us in 1–3 working days, everything else within 4. You get tracking by email as soon as it ships.

settings.title: A courier brings it to your door
settings.text: A specialist large-item courier contacts you in advance with your delivery day. Someone over 18 needs to be in to sign for it.

settings.title: 30 days to be sure
settings.text: Beds arrive flat-packed with every fitting and clear instructions. If it isn't right, tell us within 30 days — keep the packaging until you're certain.

settings.heading: 30 days to change your mind
settings.text: If the bed isn't right for the room, you have 30 days from delivery to tell us. We'll quote the collection cost before you commit to anything and refund you within 14 days of it reaching us. Anything damaged in transit is collected and replaced at our cost — just send photos within 48 hours.
